stem:
Which of the following National Parks/Wildlife Sanctuaries are in Bihar?
1. Valmiki National Park
2. Dudhwa National Park
3. Gajner Wildlife Sanctuary
4. Bhimbandh Wildlife Sanctuary
Choose the correct answer using the code given below.
expl: Among the given options, Valmiki National Park and Bhimbandh Wildlife Sanctuary are in Bihar, whereas Gajner Wildlife Sanctuary is in Rajasthan and Dudhwa National Park is located in Uttar Pradesh. Valmiki National Park is located in West Champaran district. Bhimbandh Wildlife Sanctuary is spread over 681.90 sq. km in Munger, Lakhisarai and Jamui districts.

stem: Which of the following parks/sanctuaries come under the Project tiger in Bihar?
expl: Under the Government of India’s centrally sponsored scheme for tiger conservation, “Project Tiger,” the protected areas that are notified are considered Tiger Reserves. At present, Bihar has only one Tiger Reserve—Valmiki Tiger Reserve. It is located in West Champaran district of Bihar. As the state’s second Tiger Reserve, Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuary has received in-principle approval.

stem: Which one of the following districts has the only National Park of Bihar?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: At the time of the question, no National Park was located in any of the then Bihar districts/cities given in the options. Among the options, Hazaribagh and Gaya have Hazaribagh Wildlife Sanctuary and Gautam Buddha Wildlife Sanctuary respectively. It is noteworthy that at present Gautam Buddha Wildlife Sanctuary extends into Gaya district of Bihar and also into Koderma and Chatra districts of Jharkhand. In Bihar, the only National Park has been established in West Champaran district under the name “Valmiki National Park.”

stem: Which of the following places is famous for its wildlife in Bihar?
expl: At the time of the question, Jharkhand was not a part of Bihar. Therefore, as per the options, Bodh Gaya is the correct answer because Gautam Buddha Wildlife Sanctuary extends into Gaya (Bihar) and also into Koderma and Chatra (Jharkhand), whereas Hazaribagh Wildlife Sanctuary extends in Hazaribagh district of Jharkhand. Since Bodh Gaya is a part of Gaya district (Bihar), the correct option is (b).

stem: At which place in Bihar, North India's first bird ringing station has been recently opened?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: In Bhagalpur (Bihar), India’s fourth “Bird Ringing and Monitoring Station” has been opened. The other three “Bird Ringing and Monitoring Stations” are located at Point Calimere (Tamil Nadu), Jaipur (Rajasthan) and Bhubaneswar (Odisha). It has been established through the joint efforts of the Bombay Natural History Society and the Environment, Forest and Climate Change Department, Government of Bihar. Note—In the given question, mentioning “North India” is incorrect.

stem: In which district of Bihar is the Vikramshila Gangetic Dolphin Sanctuary located?

stem: Which of the following in Bihar started the Vulture Conservation Plan?

expl: The Valmiki Tiger Reserve (VTR) of Bihar has started the Vulture Conservation Scheme.
